_comment: Quality gate policy. PROPOSAL awaiting owner approval: 'enforce' stays false (shadow mode) until approved, so nothing here can fail the build yet. In shadow mode the gate prints what WOULD fail.

rules.description: Every scan must have produced a report and actually scanned something (files, SBOM components, image targets, ZAP sites).
Any secret found in the target's code or history.
A dependency in the lockfile with a known advisory scoring 9.0 or higher (critical).
A CRITICAL image vulnerability that has a published fix.
A ZAP alert at High risk.
